name: Sapa
provinceNote: Lao Cai province now includes the former Yen Bai province. Sapa is still the name to search.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Sapa is a highland town near the Chinese border, used as a base for rice terraces, market days, and Fansipan. Mist is part of the place. Go for two nights at least, and treat village walks as visits to people’s fields, not a backdrop.
fee: Town walking is free; Fansipan and some villages charge
getThere: Overnight train or a 5–7 hour bus or limousine from Hanoi to Lao Cai, then 45 minutes up to Sapa
bestMonths: March to May and September to November
seoTitle: Sapa travel guide — rice terraces, markets, and the train from Hanoi
seoDescription: How to get from Hanoi to Sapa, how many nights to stay, and when the terraces change color.
intro: Sapa sits high above the Muong Hoa valley. The town is a resort strip with hotels and restaurants. The valleys below, including Cat Cat, Lao Chai, and Ta Van, are where the terraces and the Hmong and Giay villages are.

Ask before you photograph people. A guided walk that pays the village properly is better than a free wander that treats a home as a viewpoint. Fansipan, the country’s highest peak, is a cable car from the edge of town, not a casual add-on if the weather has shut.
gettingAround: The sleeper train from Hanoi runs to Lao Cai, not to Sapa itself. A bus or taxi climbs the last hour. Limousine vans from Hanoi go through to Sapa and save the transfer.
In the valleys, walk with a guide or hire a taxi for the trailheads. A motorbike without the right license is a common rental and a legal risk if you crash.

stayAreas.name: Sapa town
stayAreas.summary: Easiest restaurants and the cable-car road. Can be foggy and loud on weekend nights.

stayAreas.name: Ta Van or Lao Chai
stayAreas.summary: Wake up in the valley. You will want a booking that can pick you up.

eat: Town restaurants serve hotpot, grilled meat, and visitor-friendly versions of highland dishes. Homestay dinners are the more local meal.
interestsBody: Rice, mountains, and market days are the reasons to come. Bac Ha’s Sunday market is a separate trip down toward the former Yen Bai and Lao Cai lowlands.

faqs.q: Is the overnight train worth it?
faqs.a: It saves a hotel night and arrives in Lao Cai in the morning. A daytime limousine is better if you sleep badly on trains.

season.label: Typical terrace calendar
season.note: Water in the fields is often late April to May. Green follows in summer. Gold is often late August to October. Mist can hide all three.
